facts: Unfortunately, your claim for AYUSH treatment expenses is not covered under your policy.
Since the claim was for AYUSH treatment expenses, but not at an AYUSH facility, the claim is not covered.

cited_clauses.quote: Benefit : AYUSH Treatment The Company will indemnify the Insured P e r s o n , t h r o u g h C a s h l e s s o r Reimbursement Facility, up to the Sum Insured, as specified in the Policy Schedule, towards Medical Expenses incurred with respect to the Insured Person's medical treatment undergone at any AYUSH Hospitals or health care facilities for any of the listed AYUSH treatments namely Ayurveda, Sidha , Unani and Homeopathy, subject to the conditions specified below: A Claim will be admissible under this Benefit only if the Claim is a d m i s s i b l e u n d e r B e n e f i t 'Hospitalization Expenses'.

reasoning: The policy explicitly limits coverage to AYUSH treatments at AYUSH facilities, and the claim was for treatment expenses not at such a facility.
relief_sought: I request that the claim be reconsidered and approved.
document_checklist: Copy of the claim rejection letter
Medical bills, prescriptions and investigation reports
Earlier correspondence with the insurer, including any grievance acknowledgement
deadline_note: A complaint to the Insurance Ombudsman needs a written representation to the insurer first; it must then be made within one year of the insurer's rejection, or of one month after the representation was sent (Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017, Rule 14(3), checked against the published text as amended till 09.11.2023; later amendments not checked). Confirm with the Ombudsman office before relying on a date, and compute dates with the deadline tool.
